mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material WHERE id = #{materialId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND lifecycle_state IN ('ACTIVE', 'TRASHED') FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, material_id AS materialId, scope_type AS scopeType, scope_key AS scopeKey, created_by AS createdBy FROM material_scope_link WHERE material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE material_processing_job job LEFT JOIN material_processing_revision revision ON revision.id = job.revision_id LEFT JOIN material_version version_by_revision ON version_by_revision.id = revision.version_id LEFT JOIN material_upload_session upload ON upload.id = job.upload_session_id SET job.status = 'CANCELLED', job.last_error_code = 'MATERIAL_LIFECYCLE_CLOSED' WHERE job.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRY') AND (version_by_revision.material_id = #{materialId} OR upload.material_id = #{materialId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deletion_task (id, material_id, version_id, lifecycle_generation, stage, status, attempt, not_before, fence_token) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{materialId}, NULL, #{lifecycleGeneration}, 'WAIT_LEASES', 'QUEUED', 0, #{notBefore}, 0)

INSERT INTO material_lifecycle_request (owner_key, material_id, action, request_fingerprint, retention_class, lifecycle_state, lifecycle_generation, expires_at, trash_expires_at) VALUES (#{ownerKey}, #{material.id}, #{action}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{material.retentionClass}, #{material.lifecycleState}, #{material.lifecycleGeneration}, #{material.expiresAt}, #{material.trashExpiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diagram WHERE id = #{diagramId} AND user_id = #{ownerKey} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chartbook WHERE id = #{chartbookId} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT m.id AS materialId, m.lifecycle_generation AS lifecycleGeneration FROM material m WHERE m.id = #{materialId} AND m.owner_type = #{ownerType} AND m.owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND m.lifecycle_state IN ('ACTIVE', 'TRASHED')
SELECT id FROM material_version WHERE material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY id
SELECT scope_key FROM material_scope_link WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND scope_type = 'DIAGRAM' UNION SELECT diagram_id FROM diagram_source_pin WHERE material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY 1
SELECT scope_key FROM material_scope_link WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND scope_type = 'CHARTBOOK' ORDER BY scope_key
SELECT DISTINCT ce.citation_id FROM citation_evidence ce JOIN material_version v ON v.id = ce.version_id WHERE v.material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY ce.citation_id
